title: Placebo Neuroepo multisession Phase II and III
description: A randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial investigating the neuroprotective and neuromodulatory effects of intranasal NeuroEPO (erythropoietin) in Parkinson's disease patients. The dataset comprises two-session EEG recordings and clinical assessments collected at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months post-intervention, with participants stratified into active treatment and placebo groups. This Phase II/III study evaluates whether NeuroEPO exposure produces functional brain reorganization detectable via EEG source localization and associated clinical outcomes.
methods_description: Participants were enrolled in a randomized, placebo-controlled design with NeuroEPO administered intranasally according to protocol (Cuban Public Registry RPCEC00000233-En) or placebo with identical procedures. Clinical and EEG assessments were conducted at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months post-intervention. Motor severity was assessed using the Unified Parkinson Disease Rating Scale MDS UPDRS III by certified neurologists. Cumulative treatment exposure was quantified as total NeuroEPO dose, with placebo participants coded as dose = 0.
